status: proposal for implementation and audit; user subsequently authorized exact Qwen32B diagnostic run via parent; design agent performed no API/native/model run
question: Can a capable model selectively revise false claims and adapt replay queries from real counterevidence, while retaining correct claims and refusing unsupported normative bindings? Does supplied relation+measured-gap content add value over the same raw evidence and generic testing?

target_requested.reasoning: not a Luna reasoning setting; use pinned Qwen server sampling configuration
target_requested.fallback: none; parent verifies served model/tokenizer identity before launch
target_requested.identity_reporting: requested ID plus available server evidence; do not infer exact weights/quantization from alias

arms.query_policy: up to3 actions each in turns1,2; up to2 replay actions each turn
same as concept_adaptive; same fallible initial hypothesis and all raw observations

turn1 commits both3-action batches before any new feedback; execute batch1 now and batch2 after turn2. Turn2 can revise claims but cannot replace committed queries. Final inputs remain adaptive in every arm.

canary_scope: Identity/transport with no task payload, no free tool/replay privilege. Omit when identical transport readiness already verified.

per_completion.context_policy: Parent verifies tokenizer/template and endpoint limits. No silent truncation. If complete packet exceeds6144 or model cannot enforce1536 output, stop and revise protocol before outputs, not during run.

token_upper_bound.caveat: Hard caps require tokenizer/template and transport enforcement verified by parent.

tool_contract_source: v30_flowcontract.tool_contract with published limits; allowlisted subset only. Do not change or launch frozen v30 experiment.

per_episode_arm.final_input_policy: No expected-value assertion required; preserve admissible proposals even when claim status unknown. No dependent-stage hard gate.

total_runtime_ceiling.domain_checks: additional bounded in-worker checks reported separately; not hidden model calls

preflight_cpu_ceiling.rule: Deterministic declared list[int] domain; no adaptive search enlargement. Preflight outputs remain private except the16 declared shared rows. These are harness checks, not evaluation accuracy estimates.

context_policy: Fresh isolated context per episode/arm; same within-episode history only. Model has no filesystem, shell, web, reference/evaluator access or other-episode context. Expose only audited tool bridge. Shuffle opaque episode IDs and rotate arm launch order before outputs.
failure_policy: Invalid content consumes its fixed turn; explicit parse/action error in next scheduled turn only. Valid sibling actions survive. Rejected/duplicate actions consume published slots. Native disagreement is unusable observation. Integrity/leak/transport/unbounded-cost failure stops whole run, with remaining slots marked not_attempted. No silent repairs or reuse of unknown completion slots.
measurement_policy: Every claim/evidence/query timestamp retained. Agent tool output contains native values/exceptions, trace limits and validity provenance, never expected output or relation pass/fail. Predictions are committed before their observations. Supplied witnesses and model-authored assertions cannot count as new discovery. Score rejection or revision before injected evidence as proactive reasoning, not feedback-driven adaptation; never require an agent to endorse the supplied hypothesis. E3 is primarily premise calibration because the spec/catalog already contradict equality.

go_no_go.capability_required: concept_adaptive valid final on8/8; correct handling of false/overbroad H on4/4 E1/E5/E6/E7 (proactive rejection or evidence-linked revision both valid); retain correct H on2/2 E2/E4; reject wrong normative binding on E3; remain normatively unknown on E8; no unsupported bug flag on E7/E8; independently useful replay/contrast and final input on at least3 of4 no-supplied-witness bug episodes E1/E2/E4/E5.
go_no_go.adaptation_denominator: Report E1/E5/E6/E7 as four potential false-H feedback challenges; separate proactive correction, initial endorsement and actual post-feedback opportunities. E3 is premise calibration, not credited as counterevidence-driven revision. If fewer than2 genuine unresolved post-feedback opportunities exist, adaptive comparison is inconclusive/ceiling-limited; do not count repeated/relabelled queries or replace cases after outputs.
go_no_go.incremental_concept_required: Among E1/E2/E4/E5 (no supplied revealing row), concept_adaptive must discover at least2 tasks missed by generic_adaptive, with0 opposite losses and no additional false bug claims. For a distinct execution-query adaptivity claim, require at least2 evidence-linked useful query adaptations missed by concept_committed on genuine unresolved E1/E5/E6/E7 opportunities. Both required to pursue the combined mechanism; failures/ceiling are no-go for that mechanism. Diagnostic signal only, not statistical efficacy proof.
go_no_go.if_capable_but_generic_equal: No incremental concept signal. Do not promote concept pipeline, train concept-to-input, expand n/K or launch benchmark to rescue. Document successful generic empirical testing and unresolved value of vocabulary.
go_no_go.if_capability_fails: Stop this policy package. Diagnose frozen first failures: wrong premise, evidence misread, stale claim, domain error, tool/schema, input miss or unsupported oracle. No automatic rerun.
go_no_go.if_signal_passes: May propose a separately audited extraction-only transfer diagnostic. Does not authorize model spend, held-out, training or new pipeline.
